**Evaluating visibility issues**

I'm noticing that the hero text is dark and almost invisible over the image, which makes the heading and description unreadable. The download control seems okay, but the material presentation and content information is low contrast, making it barely legible. I wonder if this affects the semantic meaning, as the core text is difficult to read. While the controls work well enough, the overall presentation lacks coherence due to these visibility issues.
